## Workflow

1. The ticket should live in `.pstdio/tickets/<shorthand>/ticket.md`.
   - If `next ticket` is requested: run `pstdio tickets list --status ready`, then pull the first ticket by id.
   - If the ticket is missing, try to pull the ticket `pstdio tickets pull --id <shorthand>` and if it doesn't exist, ask the user to confirm the ticket id.
2. Update ticket checklists as you go
3. Evidence
   - Store artifacts under `.pstdio/tickets/<shorthand>/artifacts/`
4. Finish
   - Confirm everything is checked.
   - If the ticket is not completed, run `pstdio workspaces set-status --status blocked`.
   - If the ticket is completed, run `pstdio workspaces set-status --status review-ready`.

## Validation

To be considered complete and ready for review, a ticket should provide "Validation Artifacts": **verifiable outputs** produced while doing the ticket e.g. by running `<validation-command> > .pstdio/tickets/<shorthand>/artifacts/<artifact> 2>&1`

Validation Artifacts include:

- Test, Build and Run outputs
- Walkthroughs
- Screenshots or screen recordings (UI / E2E)
- `curl` responses
- Any files needed to prove the ticket is implemented correctly

Artifacts **must** be:

- Concrete
- Inspectable
- Reproducible
- Referenced as evidence in the ticket

## Output Locations

- Tickets: `.pstdio/tickets/<shorthand>/ticket.md`
- Supporting Files: `.pstdio/tickets/<shorthand>/files/`
- Validation Artifacts: `.pstdio/tickets/<shorthand>/artifacts/`

# Fix ticket workspace: board sorting, chevron toggle, list spacing, and tag compatibility

The ticket workspace (`@pstdio/ui`) has several UX bugs and a missing feature: manual sorting in board view does not reorder cards, list-view chevrons do not visually toggle on expand/collapse, there is excessive spacing between the chevron and text in list view, and the badge system uses flat string labels instead of structured tags from the dashboard tag definitions. Tags support icons (via lucide-react icon names), but icons are dropped when tags flow from definitions into badges, filters, and grouping. This ticket adds icon support across the badge, filter, and grouping systems.

## References

- Dashboard tag types (`TicketTag`, `TagOption`, `TagEntry`): `packages/pstdio-dashboard/src/features/ticket-list/types.ts`
- Tag icon/color picker + `getIconComponent()`: `packages/pstdio-dashboard/src/features/project-settings/components/tag-icon-color-picker.tsx`
- Badge builder: `packages/pstdio-dashboard/src/features/ticket-list/utils/ticket-badges.ts`
- Tag manager UI: `packages/pstdio-dashboard/src/features/project-settings/components/tag-manager.tsx`
- Tag selector components: `packages/pstdio-dashboard/src/features/ticket-list/components/tag-selector.tsx`, `single-tag-selector.tsx`

## Scope

### In Scope

- **Manual sorting (board):** Add `onReorderItem` callback to `TicketBoard` for within-column reordering via drag-and-drop with a visual drop indicator.
- **Chevron toggle (list):** Fix `ExpandToggle` in `ticket-list.tsx` so clicking it reliably toggles the chevron between collapsed (0deg) and expanded (90deg). Ensure `stopPropagation` so group row clicks don't interfere.
- **List view spacing:** Remove empty `ticketId` placeholder from group rows in `toGroupListItem` (currently `ticketId: ""` creates spacing). Tighten gap between chevron and group label text.
- **Tag-compatible badge interface with icon support:** Replace `TicketCardBadge { label: string; color?: string }` with a richer interface that includes `id` (for deduplication/stable keys) and `icon` (icon name string for rendering via `getIconComponent()`). Badges on ticket cards should render the tag icon inline when present.
- **Icon in filters:** Extend `WorkspaceFilterOption` with optional `color` and `icon` fields so the filter menu can display a colored icon swatch next to each tag value option.
- **Icon in grouping:** Extend `TicketBoardGroup` and `TicketBoardColumn` to carry optional `icon` fields. When grouping by a tag, column/group headers should display the tag option's icon and color.
- **Badge color from column config:** Derive status badge color from `getBoardColumnConfig` so it stays in sync after drag-and-drop moves a card.
- **No-grouping board view:** When `columnGrouping` is `"none"`, ignore `knownColumnKeys` and show a single "All" column.
- **Hide sub-grouping when no grouping:** Disable/hide the row-grouping dropdown in `DisplayMenu` when column grouping is `"none"`.
- **Remove assignee:** Drop `"assignee"` from default grouping, display property, and filter category options.
- **Split ****ticket-board.tsx****:** Extract `BoardColumnHeader` and `BoardGroupSection` into their own files to keep each under 350 lines.
- Storybook stories for all visual changes (no unit tests for UI).
- No documentation updates required.

### Out of Scope

- Clickable label badges for toggling filters (future ticket).
- List-mode drag-and-drop (future ticket).
- Keyboard accessibility for badges (future ticket).

## Implementation Notes

### 1. Tag-compatible badge interface with icons

Replace `TicketCardBadge` with a tag-aware interface that includes icon support:

```ts
// ticket-card.tsx
export interface TicketCardBadge {
  id?: string;          // stable key — falls back to index if omitted
  label: string;
  color?: string;
  icon?: string | null; // lucide-react icon name, resolved via getIconComponent()
}
```

Render the icon inline in the badge when present. The `getIconComponent()` utility from `tag-icon-color-picker.tsx` maps icon name strings to lucide-react components (defaults to `Circle` when null). This utility should be shared or duplicated in `@pstdio/ui` so badges can render icons without importing from the dashboard package.

Update `toBadges` in `tickets-workspace.tsx` to accept an optional `badgeBuilder` callback prop so consumers (dashboard) can supply their own tag-resolution logic that includes icon data.

### 2. Propagate icons through TagEntry and BadgeContext

The current `TagEntry` type (`{ id, name, color, tagName }`) drops the `icon` field from `TagOption`. Add `icon: string | null` to `TagEntry` and update `BadgeContext` consumers to propagate it:

```ts
// types.ts (dashboard)
export type TagEntry = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  color: TicketStatusColor;
  tagName: string;
  icon: string | null;  // NEW
};
```

Update badge builder in `ticket-badges.ts` to include icon:

```ts
.map((tag) => ({ label: tag.name, color: tag.color, icon: tag.icon }));
```

Update tag entry construction in `tickets-panel.tsx` to include `icon: o.icon`.

### 3. Filter options with icon and color

Extend `WorkspaceFilterOption` to carry visual metadata:

```ts
// types.ts (ui)
export interface WorkspaceFilterOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  color?: string;           // tag option color
  icon?: string | null;     // tag option icon name
}
```

Update `collectCategoryOptions()` in `tickets-workspace.tsx` to accept tag metadata and populate these fields for tag/label filter categories.

Update `FilterMenu` rendering to display icons and color indicators next to tag filter options when present.

### 4. Grouping with icon and color

Extend group/column types to carry visual metadata:

```ts
// ticket-board.tsx
export interface TicketBoardGroup {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  color?: string;
  icon?: string | null;    // NEW
  items: TicketBoardItem[];
}

export interface TicketBoardColumn {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  color?: string;
  icon?: string | null;    // NEW
  // ... existing fields
}
```

When grouping by a tag value, the column/group header should render the tag option's icon (via `getIconComponent()`) alongside its colored label.

### 5. Board manual sorting

Add `onReorderItem?: (itemId: string, columnId: string, targetIndex: number) => void` to `TicketBoardProps`. During drag-over within the same column, calculate the drop index from mouse position relative to sibling cards and render a thin colored drop indicator line.

### 6. Chevron toggle fix

In `ticket-list.tsx`, the `ExpandToggle` should be a `<button>` with `onClick` calling `row.toggleExpanded()` and `event.stopPropagation()`. The chevron rotation should read from `row.getIsExpanded()`.

### 7. No-grouping board fix

In `tickets-workspace.tsx`, guard `knownColumnKeys` so it is `undefined` when `columnGrouping === "none"`.

### 8. File split

Extract from `ticket-board.tsx`:

- `board-column-header.tsx` — column header with label, count, color bar, actions, create button
- `board-group-section.tsx` — collapsible group section with its own drag handlers

### Key files

- `packages/ui/src/components/tickets/ticket-card.tsx` — badge interface + icon rendering
- `packages/ui/src/components/tickets/ticket-board.tsx` — board DnD, column rendering, group/column icon support
- `packages/ui/src/components/tickets/ticket-list.tsx` — chevron, spacing
- `packages/ui/src/components/tickets/tickets-workspace.tsx` — `toBadges`, `knownColumnKeys` guard, `getBoardColumnConfig` color pass-through
- `packages/ui/src/components/tickets/types.ts` — remove assignee from defaults, extend filter/group types with icon
- `packages/ui/src/components/tickets/display-menu.tsx` — hide sub-grouping when no grouping
- `packages/ui/src/components/tickets/filter-menu.tsx` — render icons/colors in filter options
- `packages/pstdio-dashboard/src/features/ticket-list/types.ts` — add `icon` to `TagEntry`
- `packages/pstdio-dashboard/src/features/ticket-list/utils/ticket-badges.ts` — propagate icon through badge builder
- `packages/pstdio-dashboard/src/features/ticket-list/components/tickets-panel.tsx` — include icon when building tag entries

## Documentation

No documentation updates required.

## Steps

- [ ] Green - Update `TicketCardBadge` interface in `ticket-card.tsx` to add optional `id` and `icon` fields. Use `badge.id ?? index` as React key. Render icon inline in badge when present.
- [ ] Green - Add `icon: string | null` to `TagEntry` in dashboard `types.ts`. Update `tickets-panel.tsx` to include `icon: o.icon` when building tag entries.
- [ ] Green - Update badge builder in `ticket-badges.ts` to include `icon` in tag badge output.
- [ ] Green - Extend `WorkspaceFilterOption` in UI `types.ts` with optional `color` and `icon` fields. Update `collectCategoryOptions()` to populate them.
- [ ] Green - Update `FilterMenu` rendering in `filter-menu.tsx` to display icon and color swatch next to tag filter options.
- [ ] Green - Add optional `icon` field to `TicketBoardGroup` and `TicketBoardColumn`. Render icon in column/group headers when present.
- [ ] Green - Fix `ExpandToggle` in `ticket-list.tsx`: wrap chevron in a `<button>` with `stopPropagation`, read rotation from `row.getIsExpanded()`.
- [ ] Green - Fix list-view spacing: remove empty `ticketId` placeholder gap for group rows; tighten chevron-to-label spacing.
- [ ] Green - Guard `knownColumnKeys` in `tickets-workspace.tsx` so it is `undefined` when `columnGrouping === "none"`.
- [ ] Green - Hide sub-grouping dropdown in `display-menu.tsx` when column grouping is `"none"`.
- [ ] Green - Remove `"assignee"` from `DEFAULT_GROUPING_OPTIONS`, `DEFAULT_DISPLAY_PROPERTY_OPTIONS`, and default filter categories in `types.ts` and `tickets-workspace.tsx`.
- [ ] Green - Pass `statusColor` from `getBoardColumnConfig` into `toBadges` so status badge color stays in sync after drag.
- [ ] Green - Add `onReorderItem` prop to `TicketBoard` and implement within-column drag reorder with drop indicator.
- [ ] Refactor - Extract `board-column-header.tsx` and `board-group-section.tsx` from `ticket-board.tsx`.
- [ ] Refactor - Update `@pstdio/ui` exports in `index.ts` for new files.
- [ ] Stories - Add storybook stories: `BadgeWithIcons`, `FilterMenuWithIcons`, `GroupHeaderWithIcon`, `BadgeColorUpdatesAfterDrag`, `NoGroupingSingleColumn`, `SubGroupingHiddenWhenNoGrouping`, `ChevronDirectClick`, `WithinColumnReorder`.
- [ ] Validation - Run `bun run validate` and confirm all checks pass.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `TicketCardBadge` accepts `id` and `icon` fields; badges render tag icons inline when present.
- [ ] Tag icons flow from `TagOption` → `TagEntry` → badge output without being dropped.
- [ ] Filter menu displays icon and color swatch next to tag value options when metadata is available.
- [ ] Board/list group headers render tag option icon and color when grouping by a tag.
- [ ] Board view: dragging a card within the same column reorders it; a visual drop indicator shows the target position.
- [ ] List view: clicking the chevron toggles between collapsed (right-pointing) and expanded (down-pointing) states reliably.
- [ ] List view: no excess whitespace between chevron and group label text.
- [ ] Repeated tag labels across multi-select categories render with stable, unique React keys.
- [ ] Board view with `columnGrouping: "none"` shows a single "All" column regardless of `knownColumnKeys`.
- [ ] Sub-grouping dropdown is hidden when column grouping is "none".
- [ ] Assignee is removed from default grouping, display, and filter options.
- [ ] Status badge color updates to match the destination column config after a drag-and-drop move.
- [ ] All files in `packages/ui/src/components/tickets/` remain under 350 lines.
- [ ] `bun run validate` passes.

1	import { Grid, GridItem, Icon, IconButton, Popover, Text } from "@chakra-ui/react";
2	import {
3	  AlertTriangle,
4	  BookOpen,
5	  Bug,
6	  ChartColumnIncreasing,
7	  CheckCircle,
8	  Circle,
9	  CircleQuestionMark,
10	  Clock,
11	  Code,
12	  Eye,
13	  Flag,
14	  Flame,
15	  Gauge,
16	  Lightbulb,
17	  Shield,
18	  ShieldAlert,
19	  Sparkles,

21	  Tag,
22	  Wrench,
23	} from "lucide-react";
24	import type { ComponentType } from "react";
25	import type { TicketStatusColor } from "@/features/ticket-list/types";
26	
27	const TAG_COLORS: TicketStatusColor[] = [
28	  "gray",
29	  "red",
30	  "orange",
31	  "yellow",
32	  "green",
33	  "teal",
34	  "blue",
35	  "cyan",
36	  "purple",
37	  "pink",
38	];
39	
40	const TAG_ICONS = [
41	  { name: "circle", icon: Circle },
42	  { name: "bug", icon: Bug },
43	  { name: "sparkles", icon: Sparkles },
44	  { name: "book-open", icon: BookOpen },
45	  { name: "wrench", icon: Wrench },
46	  { name: "gauge", icon: Gauge },
47	  { name: "alert-triangle", icon: AlertTriangle },
48	  { name: "star", icon: Star },
49	  { name: "flag", icon: Flag },
50	  { name: "flame", icon: Flame },
51	  { name: "lightbulb", icon: Lightbulb },
52	  { name: "shield", icon: Shield },
53	  { name: "eye", icon: Eye },
54	  { name: "clock", icon: Clock },
55	  { name: "check-circle", icon: CheckCircle },
56	  { name: "tag", icon: Tag },
57	  { name: "code", icon: Code },
58	  { name: "chart-column-increasing", icon: ChartColumnIncreasing },
59	  { name: "circle-question-mark", icon: CircleQuestionMark },
60	  { name: "shield-alert", icon: ShieldAlert },
61	] as const;
62	
63	export const getIconComponent = (name: string | null): ComponentType => {
64	  if (!name) return Circle;
65	  const entry = TAG_ICONS.find((i) => i.name === name);
66	  return entry?.icon ?? Circle;
67	};
68	
69	interface TagIconColorPickerProps {
70	  color: TicketStatusColor;
71	  icon: string | null;
72	  onColorChange: (color: TicketStatusColor) => void;
73	  onIconChange: (icon: string | null) => void;
74	  disabled?: boolean;
75	}
76	
77	export const TagIconColorPicker = (props: TagIconColorPickerProps) => {
78	  const { color, icon, onColorChange, onIconChange, disabled } = props;
79	  const IconComponent = getIconComponent(icon);
80	  const selectedIconName = icon ?? "circle";
81	
82	  return (
83	    <Popover.Root>
84	      <Popover.Trigger asChild>
85	        <IconButton size="2xs" variant="ghost" disabled={disabled} aria-label="Pick color and icon">
86	          <Icon as={IconComponent} boxSize="14px" color={`${color}.500`} />
87	        </IconButton>
88	      </Popover.Trigger>
89	      <Popover.Positioner>
90	        <Popover.Content w="320px" p="sm" bg="bg">
91	          <Text textStyle="label/S" mb="xs">
92	            Color
93	          </Text>
94	          <Grid templateColumns="repeat(10, 1fr)" gap="2xs" mb="md">
95	            {TAG_COLORS.map((c) => (
96	              <GridItem key={c}>
97	                <IconButton
98	                  size="2xs"
99	                  variant={c === color ? "solid" : "ghost"}
100	                  colorPalette={c}
101	                  onClick={() => onColorChange(c)}
102	                  aria-label={c}
103	                >
104	                  <Icon as={Circle} boxSize="14px" fill={`${c}.500`} color={`${c}.500`} />
105	                </IconButton>
106	              </GridItem>
107	            ))}
108	          </Grid>
109	          <Text textStyle="label/S" mb="xs">
110	            Icon
111	          </Text>
112	          <Grid templateColumns="repeat(5, 1fr)" gap="2xs">
113	            {TAG_ICONS.map((entry) => (
114	              <GridItem key={entry.name}>
115	                <IconButton
116	                  size="2xs"
117	                  variant={entry.name === selectedIconName ? "solid" : "ghost"}
118	                  onClick={() => onIconChange(entry.name === "circle" ? null : entry.name)}
119	                  aria-label={entry.name}
120	                >
121	                  <Icon as={entry.icon} boxSize="14px" />
122	                </IconButton>
123	              </GridItem>
124	            ))}
125	          </Grid>
126	        </Popover.Content>
127	      </Popover.Positioner>
128	    </Popover.Root>
129	  );
130	};
